description: This file defines caching mechanisms and classes related to dynamic logging for the LangfuseLoggers in the litellm project. It includes a specialized in-memory cache that ensures proper cleanup of Langfuse clients and a wrapper to prevent memory leaks by caching logging objects based on credential and service information.

classes.name: LangfuseInMemoryCache
classes.description: A custom in-memory cache class that overrides the key removal method to ensure proper cleanup of Langfuse clients, especially handling LangFuseLogger instances to shut down their associated threads.

classes.name: DynamicLoggingCache
classes.description: A caching utility class designed to store and retrieve logging objects based on a hash of credentials and service name, preventing memory leaks caused by repeated client initialization.

methods.name: None _remove_key(self, key: str)
methods.description: Overrides the parent class method to include cleanup of LangFuseLogger instances by flushing and shutting down associated Langfuse clients.

methods.name: str get_cache_key(self, args: dict)
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash string key based on the provided arguments, used for caching.

methods.name: Optional[Any] get_cache(self, credentials: dict, service_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached logging object based on provided credentials and service name.

methods.name: None set_cache(self, credentials: dict, service_name: str, logging_obj: Any)
methods.description: Stores a logging object in the cache with a key derived from credentials and service name.

ctags.name: get_cache
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_cache(self, credentials: dict, service_name: str) -> Optional[Any]:$/

ctags.name: set_cache
ctags.pattern: /^    def set_cache(self, credentials: dict, service_name: str, logging_obj: Any) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (self, credentials: dict, service_name: str, logging_obj: Any)
